_comment: Rotating pool of engagement-CTA comments. scripts/upload_to_youtube.py posts one of these as a top-level comment on every uploaded Short, advancing next_index each time so the pool cycles through before repeating. Add/edit prompts freely - keep them short (under ~150 chars), on-topic for a US tax/finance channel, and genuinely inviting a reply rather than generic bait.
